## Final discounted tariffs
- Hall Dormitory: ₹299 per bed / night
- 4-Bed Dormitory: ₹350 per bed / night
- 8-Bed Mixed Dormitory: ₹399 per bed / night
- 1BHK Cooler Room: ₹999 per room / night
- 1BHK AC Room: ₹1,500 per room / night
- 2BHK Entire Room: ₹2,999 per night for up to 5 guests; ₹3,500 per night for 6–8 guests (maximum 8); prior confirmation required and available only when both 1BHK rooms are vacant

## Important booking note
A booking request is not a reservation. Guests must confirm availability, any applicable taxes, payment method and cancellation terms with Awara. After Awara confirms availability and a USD amount with an international guest, Awara may provide a signed, expiring PayPal Checkout link that verifies the payment status. A paid amount does not itself confirm a stay. PayPal.Me (https://paypal.me/awara888) is a manual fallback, and PayPal cannot receive domestic payments from Indian customers.
